description: Classic Azure DevOps Release definition for Playwright/ReqnRoll/NUnit automation from the CI bin artifact (artifact name: testpackage, alias _FF_CI). Stages are independent/manual: Assembly Execution (DLLs + optional TestCategory filter), Test Suite Execution (test plan/suite/configuration), and Test Plan On-Demand Execution (uses $(test.RunId) with ManualTestRunId fallback).

workflowTasks.name: Install latest stable Visual Studio Test Platform
Prepare and validate CI automation artifact

inputs.script:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$downloadRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath("$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)")
$releaseId = "$(Release.ReleaseId)"
if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($releaseId) -or $releaseId -like '$(*') { $releaseId = [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N') }
$stageKey = "$(StageKey)"
$stageRoot = Join-Path "$(Agent.TempDirectory)" ("FFTestAutomation\{0}\{1}" -f $releaseId, $stageKey)
$packageRoot = Join-Path $stageRoot 'package'
$binRoot = Join-Path $packageRoot 'bin'

if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stageRoot) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stageRoot -Recurse -Force }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $binRoot -Force | Out-Null

$coreDll = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $downloadRoot -Recurse -File -Filter 'InsuranceAutomation.Core.dll' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Where-Object { $_.FullName -match '[\\/]InsuranceAutomation\.Core[\\/]$(BuildConfiguration)[\\/]net8\.0[\\/]InsuranceAutomation\.Core\.dll$' } |
    Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $coreDll) { throw 'Unable to locate InsuranceAutomation.Core.dll in downloaded CI artifact.' }
$sourceBinRoot = $coreDll.Directory.Parent.Parent.Parent.FullName
robocopy $sourceBinRoot $binRoot /E /R:2 /W:1
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ge 8) { throw "robocopy failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE" }

$required = @(
  'InsuranceAutomation.Core\$(BuildConfiguration)\net8.0\InsuranceAutomation.Core.dll',
  'CommercialLines.DuckCreek.Tests\$(BuildConfiguration)\net8.0\CommercialLines.DuckCreek.Tests.dll',
  'CommercialLines.ExpertQuote.Tests\$(BuildConfiguration)\net8.0\CommercialLines.ExpertQuote.Tests.dll',
  'PersonalLines.DuckCreek.Tests\$(BuildConfiguration)\net8.0\PersonalLines.DuckCreek.Tests.dll'
)
foreach ($relative in $required) {
  $path = Join-Path $binRoot $relative
  if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Required CI artifact file is missing: $relative" }
}

$resultsRoot = Join-Path $packageRoot "$(StageResultsDirectory)"
foreach ($name in @('Runner','NUnit','NUnitWork')) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path (Join-Path $resultsRoot $name) -Force | Out-Null }

$headless = $true
if (-not [bool]::TryParse("$(Headless)", [ref]$headless)) { throw "Headless must be true or false; received '$(Headless)'." }

$configDir = Join-Path $packageRoot 'config'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $configDir -Force | Out-Null
$frameworkConfig = Join-Path $configDir 'framework.json'
$config = @{
  browser = @{
    headless = $headless
    channel = 'msedge'
    fallbackBrowser = 'chromium'
  }
  reporting = @{
    resultsRoot = '$(StageResultsDirectory)'
    artifactRoot = 'Artifacts'
  }
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20
Set-Content -LiteralPath $frameworkConfig -Value $config -Encoding UTF8

$runSettingsPath = Join-Path $packageRoot 'Tosca.runsettings'
$runSettings = @'
<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?>
<RunSettings>
  <RunConfiguration>
    <ResultsDirectory>$(StageResultsDirectory)\Runner</ResultsDirectory>
    <MaxCpuCount>3</MaxCpuCount>
  </RunConfiguration>
  <NUnit>
    <WorkDirectory>$(StageResultsDirectory)\NUnitWork</WorkDirectory>
    <NumberOfTestWorkers>3</NumberOfTestWorkers>
    <UseParentFQNForParametrizedTests>false</UseParentFQNForParametrizedTests>
    <TestOutputXml>$(StageResultsDirectory)\NUnit</TestOutputXml>
  </NUnit>
</RunSettings>
'@
Set-Content -LiteralPath $runSettingsPath -Value $runSettings -Encoding UTF8

$playwrightScript = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $binRoot -Recurse -File -Filter 'playwright.ps1' |
    Where-Object { Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $_.Directory.FullName 'Microsoft.Playwright.dll') } |
    Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $playwrightScript) { throw 'No playable playwright.ps1 + Microsoft.Playwright.dll pair exists in bin artifact.' }
& $playwrightScript.FullName install "$(PlaywrightBrowser)"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Playwright $(PlaywrightBrowser) installation failed with exit code $LASTEXITCODE." }

Write-Host "##vso[task.setvariable variable=TEST_PACKAGE_ROOT]$packageRoot"
Write-Host "##vso[task.setvariable variable=TEST_FRAMEWORK_CONFIG]$frameworkConfig"
Write-Host "##vso[task.setvariable variable=TEST_RESULTS_ROOT]$resultsRoot"
Write-Host "##vso[task.setvariable variable=TEST_REPOSITORY_ROOT]$packageRoot"
Write-Host "##vso[task.setvariable variable=VSTEST_RUNSETTINGS]$runSettingsPath"

Write-Host "Prepared test package: $packageRoot"
Write-Host "Stage result scope: $(StageResultsDirectory)"
$global:LASTEXITCODE = 0
